Owner has agreed to permit Developer to utilize Owner's Available Development Rights, on the terms and conditions hereinafter set forth, it being understood and agreed, however, that Owner is retaining for its own benefit all Floor Area Development Rights and all other rights pertaining to Owner's Building and Owner's Property as same exists as of the Effective Date other than the Available Development Rights, and as limited by the provisions of this Agreement, and excluding any floor area and development rights resulting from any upward revisions after the Effective Date by the City of the allowable floor area ratio (such Floor Area Development Rights being retained by Seller are referred to herein as the "Retained Development Rights"); NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of Ten Dollars ($10.00) and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties heretoagree asfollows: ARTICLEI DECLARATIONOFRESTRICTIONS Section 1.1.
